reviews.title: Great transitional app!
reviews.contents: Loved this app during my pregnancy, and it has transitioned well into infancy. The articles offered here have kept me informed on what to expect. This has helped tremendously as a first time mom!

reviews.title: Used to love the app
reviews.contents: I have been enjoying the app, but I’m disappointed to see that the community asked question section has been taken off. That was my favourite part of the app.

reviews.title: Basic as heck
reviews.contents: Info is super generic and dated, would not rely on this app for health information!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.contents: This is a really good app to follow each week and something to look forward to reading as each week goes by. Even for my other kids they love checking to see which food the baby will be e size of next.

reviews.title: A must have for new moms
reviews.contents: I have loved using this app as a first time mom expecting my first baby! The weekly updates are so neat to learn about and I love that I can add registry items right in the app!

reviews.title: A must have for every preggy
reviews.contents: Informative and educative especially for a FTM.

reviews.title: Overall Poor App; use to track only
reviews.contents: Good to track but useless and random size comparisons of what the baby is day to day. Also there are often spelling mistakes overlooked, so someone either is not paying enough attention when writing it does not care enough about the information to reread their data. Not recommended at all.

reviews.title: Good but glitchy
reviews.contents:
I used this app throughout pregnancy and found it really helpful to have preselected reading resources each day. Narrowing down what to focus one each day helped me feel less overwhelmed. The weekly highlights were also helpful. The community feature is also good although navigation could be easier. 

However, I’ve found the app increasingly glitchy. Some days you click an article and it’s empty, or it’s from 10 years ago (research and insights change). It feels like no one is checking or updating the library. Sometimes a pregnancy article will still pop up - what is pushed through to read is not always updated to reflect baby’s age now. 

I will also say the fruit and veg used to track baby’s size during pregnancy were sometimes odd - a fruit that is typically small might come the week after a long vegetable, which could be confusing.

reviews.title: Ok, but…
reviews.contents: While I love the resourcefulness of this app, it will not let me scroll through my search to go through any articles on specific questions I have. Very inconvenient and stressful for someone suffering from PPA, and all moms whom are breast feeding and sleep deprived trying to find specific information like how much breast milk baby needs, and how best to store it based on babies age (which need for will fluctuate).
